units.source_text: 髭黑大将闻知此事，说道：“果然不出所料！

en.t: When General Higekuro heard of this, he said, "It is just as I expected!

units.source_text: 这萤兵部卿亲王本来是个浮薄男子啊。”

en.t: This Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, was always a frivolous man."

units.source_text: 他当初就不赞许这门亲事，现在颇感不快。

en.t: He had disapproved of the marriage from the start, and now he felt deeply displeased.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍闻知亲近的人遇人不淑，也很懊丧，她想：“假使我当初嫁了这个人，不知源氏主君和太政大臣作何感想。”

en.t: Lady Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, was also distressed to hear that someone close to her had married badly, and she thought, "If I had married this man back then, I wonder what Lord Genji and the Chancellor would have thought."

units.source_text: 回想当年之事，觉得甚是可笑，却又可叹。

en.t: Looking back on those days, she found it very laughable, yet also lamentable.

units.source_text: 她又想：“当年我并不想嫁给他。

en.t: She also thought, "At the time, I did not want to marry him.

units.source_text: 只是他的来信缠绵悱恻，一往情深。

en.t: But his letters were tender and sorrowful, filled with single-hearted devotion.

units.source_text: 后来他知道我嫁给了髭黑，也许会指摘我不识风趣。

en.t: Later, when he learned that I had married Higekuro, he may have reproached me for having no sense of refinement.

units.source_text: 年来每逢想起了这一点，总觉得十分可耻。

en.t: Over the years, whenever I remembered this, I always felt deeply ashamed.

units.source_text: 现在他已经做了我的女婿，说不定会把我的前情告诉我的前房女儿，倒是很可担心的。”

en.t: Now that he has become my son-in-law, he may tell my daughter by my late husband about my former feelings, and that is truly worrying."

units.source_text: 玉鬘也很关怀真木柱，她装作不知道真木柱夫妻间的情况，常常叫真木柱的两个兄弟向这一对新夫妇问好。

en.t: Tamakazura also cared deeply about Makibashira, and pretending not to know the state of Makibashira's marriage, she often had Makibashira's two brothers send greetings to the newly married couple.

units.source_text: 因此萤兵部卿亲王也可怜真木柱，不忍和她离异。

en.t: Because of this, Prince Hotaru also pitied Makibashira and could not bring himself to separate from her.

units.source_text: 只是式部卿亲王的夫人，是个爱唠叨的女人，始终不满意于这个新外孙女婿，常常咒骂。

en.t: However, the wife of Prince Shikibu was a nagging woman, and she remained dissatisfied with this new grandson-in-law and often cursed him.

units.source_text: 她愤愤不平地说：“嫁给亲王，不能像入宫那样享受荣华富贵，那么至少也须得到丈夫专心怜爱，安乐度日，方可聊以慰情呀！”

en.t: She said indignantly, "If marrying a prince does not bring the splendor and wealth of entering the palace, then at the very least she ought to receive her husband's devoted affection and live in comfort; only then would there be some consolation!"

units.source_text: 这些话传达到了萤兵部卿亲王耳中，他想：“如此骂我，可真稀奇。

en.t: These words reached Prince Hotaru's ears, and he thought, "To be cursed like this is truly unusual.

units.source_text: 从前我的爱妻在世之时，我也常常寻花问柳，逢场作戏，却并不曾听到她如此严厉的骂声。”

en.t: In the past, when my beloved wife was alive, I often went out seeking women and indulged in passing amusements, yet I never heard such harsh scolding from her."

units.source_text: 他心情不快，越发恋念从前的夫人了，便日日独自笼闭在自己家里，忧愁度日。

en.t: Displeased, he missed his former wife all the more, and day after day he shut himself up alone at home, spending his time in sorrow.

units.source_text: 说说容易，不觉过了两年。

en.t: It is easy to say, but before anyone knew it, two years had passed.

units.source_text: 此种生涯，渐渐过惯，这对夫妻至今还只是保持不即不离的关系。

en.t: Gradually they grew used to this way of life, and even now the couple merely maintain a relationship that is neither close nor entirely apart.
